Tested locally, it works as expected in Forward+ and Compatibility.

In Mobile, I get a shader compilation error (and subsequent error spam) though: [test_clearcoat_mobile.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22908830/test_clearcoat_mobile.zip)

Visual comparison in Forward+:

-|-|-

Tested again (rebased on top of `master` https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/369afc7b46d87dd28fc70976fc66875e76e36101), it works as expected on all renderers. Code looks good to me.

PS: I noticed we have several functions using PascalCase naming like `V_Kelemen` added to this PR. That said, we already have `ShlickFresnel` in `master`. We should probably look into uniformizing names to `snake_case` in a future PR.
Looks very good! I tested locally and it works as expected. The code seems to be correct as well, I compared it with the Filament document and it looks like this matches its implementation correctly.
